results.title: Questionnaire Secret Santa Père Noël Stylé - Idée Cadeau Secret Santa
results.description:
Ce questionnaire Secret Santa moderne, illustré d’un Père Noël stylé et décontracté, a été conçu pour organiser facilement un échange de cadeaux en entreprise, en famille ou entre amis. Son design contemporain en fait un support convivial, accessible et apprécié de tous. Parfait pour les DRH, office managers, ou toute personne organisant un événement privé, il rassemble rapidement toutes les informations nécessaires pour choisir un cadeau vraiment adapté.

La fiche inclut toutes les informations essentielles : prénom, nom, taille de t-shirt, allergies… Ses rubriques détaillées permettent de connaître les restaurants préférés, fast-foods favoris, desserts aimés, bonbons préférés, magasins favoris, couleurs appréciées, parfums, ainsi que l’éventuelle équipe sportive soutenue. La section “aimes-tu…” précise les goûts concernant les plaids, mugs, bougies, chocolats, lotions, cartes cadeaux, etc.

La rubrique “plutôt ceci ou cela” aide à cerner les préférences générales : café ou thé, sucré ou salé, films ou livres, détente ou aventure, intérieur ou extérieur, fast-food ou restaurant. Une section personnelle permet d’indiquer les envies, besoins, indispensables et objets déjà possédés. La partie “budget” (5, 10, 25 ou 50 €) facilite encore davantage la sélection d’un cadeau qui fera plaisir.

Le questionnaire peut être téléchargé et imprimé chez soi, ou envoyé déjà imprimé sur papier cartonné A4 pour un rendu propre et professionnel. Chaque organisateur peut ainsi choisir la solution la plus pratique.

Idéal pour renforcer la cohésion en entreprise, mais aussi pour les familles et groupes d’amis, ce modèle s’adapte à toutes les situations. Il permet d’organiser un Secret Santa moderne, simple et sans stress.

Design exclusif Les Bambétises
Format A4 — Fabrication française

results.title: Advent Calendar Activity Cards Printable Christmas Countdown for Family with 25 Days of Activities and a Cover Card
results.description:

Two printable PDF files with the same 26 cards in both paper sizes.
One file in US Letter size and one file in A4 size.

A read me file with print tips and simple ways to use the cards.
The cards print 4 to a page with dashed cut guides on every page.
Each printed card measures about 3.6 by 4.8 inches on US Letter paper.

THE 25 DAYS
Day 1: Bake a batch of cookies and share a plate with a neighbor
Day 2: Make hot cocoa and watch a favorite Christmas movie together
Day 3: Write a thank you card for someone who helps your family
Day 4: Take an evening walk and count the Christmas lights on your street
Day 5: Cut paper snowflakes and hang them in the windows
Day 6: Call a grandparent or an old friend and tell them you love them
Day 7: Build a blanket fort and read a Christmas story inside it
Day 8: Choose a toy or a warm coat to give away to a family in need
Day 9: Make a Christmas card for your mail carrier or a kind helper
Day 10: Play a board game together by candlelight after dinner
Day 11: Take turns naming three good things from this year
Day 12: Draw a picture of your happiest Christmas memory
Day 13: Make a simple ornament from things you already have at home
Day 14: Hide a kind note where a family member will find it
Day 15: Dance in the kitchen to your favorite Christmas songs
Day 16: Make hot spiced cider and share stories from when you were small
Day 17: Wrap a small gift for someone who is often forgotten
Day 18: Put out seeds or crumbs for the birds and watch who comes
Day 19: Light a candle and share your hopes for the new year
Day 20: Make a warm drink for someone who works outdoors in the cold
Day 21: Tidy one small corner of the home together and make it festive
Day 22: Learn the words to one carol and sing it all together
Day 23: Bake muffins or bread and give half away while still warm
Day 24: Write a letter to Santa or a family wish list to keep for years
Day 25: Read the Christmas story out loud together by the tree

HOW IT WORKS
Buy the set and download your files from Etsy.
Open the file for your paper size and print at 100 percent scale.
Cut each card along the dashed guide lines.
Tuck one card into an advent calendar pocket or an envelope or a jar.
Open one card each morning and enjoy the activity together that day.
Busy day ahead? Swap two days around and keep the fun going.
Clip the cards along a string or stand the card of the day on the mantel.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a digital download. Nothing will be posted to your home.
You need a home printer or a print shop.
Colors can look a little different on paper than on a screen.
The set is for personal use in your home or classroom.
Please do not share or resell the files themselves.
